notes: Episode 01 story-director cues. Display-only framing for DecisionNodeView / EpisodePlayer. Clinical truth remains in node clinicalState + legacy domain meters + Action Stations engine snapshot. LLM may rephrase flavour only when STORY_LLM_MODE allows.

ep01-arrival-framing.intent: Lock chronology and stage AAC for wake — silence is sedation, not incapacity.
ep01-arrival-framing.bridge: ICU begins after the bay restored sustained circulation. Communication systems wait with Rohan for wake.

ep01-infection-renal.intent: Hold infection versus renal trade-off without a single physiological win.
ep01-infection-renal.bridge: Coverage and reserve pull in tension. Choose a path; do not pretend the tension disappears.

ep01-consent-dialogue.intent: Address Rohan first; WAIT and silence are never consent.
ep01-consent-dialogue.bridge: Consent is paced to access. A slow answer is still an answer.

ep01-pressure-rise.intent: Investigate pressure with Action Stations — readiness is not indication.
ep01-pressure-rise.bridge: Right-sided pressure asks for evidence workup. Station assets explain; they do not invent replacement.

ep01-consequence-a.intent: Show Branch A consequence without closing authorship.
ep01-consequence-a.bridge: The chosen airway emphasis lands. Communication access stays in scope for what comes next.

ep01-consequence-b.intent: Show Branch B consequence without closing authorship.
ep01-consequence-b.bridge: The chosen path lands with its delayed costs visible. Rohan remains addressable.

ep01-consequence-c.intent: Preview cardiac instability without ending at ROSC.
ep01-consequence-c.bridge: Cardiac sensitivity surfaces. The season continues into later instability work — not a victory frame.

ep01-sedation-delirium.intent: Lighten sedation with stop-on-signal and AAC restore in mind.
ep01-sedation-delirium.bridge: As sedation lightens, access returns before questions multiply. STOP remains authoritative.

ep01-kit-readiness.intent: Weight the community emergency bag without unpaid family clinical labour.
ep01-kit-readiness.bridge: Kit readiness is transfer planning — airway, AAC, and governance docs — not a procedure trainer.

ep01-home-school.intent: Keep home and school membership active mid-ICU.
ep01-home-school.bridge: Membership does not vanish because the calendar moved. Privacy and paid night staffing stay on the board.

ep01-debrief-hook.intent: Open debrief without a perfect-path badge or ROSC ending.
ep01-debrief-hook.bridge: Reflection starts here. Cardiac instability and authorship beats remain ahead in the season.
